title: Organisation
intro: These settings apply to every member and every mailbox of the organisation.
name: Name
skipAutomated: Set plainly automated mail aside first (newsletters, notifications)
modelHint: Used by members who have not chosen their own. Leave empty for the server's.
key: OpenRouter API key of the organisation
keyHint: Encrypted in the database. Used by every member who has no key of their own.
deleteText: Every member’s account, every mailbox connection, the prompts and everything saras kept are erased, for everyone. The mailboxes themselves are not touched.
deleteName: Name of the organisation, to confirm
confirmDelete: Delete {organization} and everything saras holds for it, for all its members? This cannot be undone.
sorting: Sorting: which emails need a reply
writing: Writing: when the AI writes a proposal
sortingHint: Sorting by the AI costs one request per 20 emails fetched, and sends it their sender, subject, beginning of text and attachment names.
writingHint: Writing at fetch sends the AI the content of each email to handle, at most ten per fetch and mailbox. Nothing is ever sent to the correspondent without a member’s confirmation.
